method: the serialization-layer decorator (the SPI factory wrapped via reflection — no production changes): every reader call = parse+build, every writer call = serialization; the IO floor = raw page-cache-warm reads of the same files; the engine = the residual; the bytes lever = gzip on the YAML files (a floor of the binary size reduction); medians over rounds; the page cache deliberately warm (the conservative choice for the parse share — disk-cold would shrink it)
disclosures: the structure-metadata reads at open happen before the decorator install (tiny, one-time)
journal appends do NOT go through the SPI factory — the write arm measures the CHECKPOINT write-out (the bulk serialization)
the cold FIRST lookup is the truest cold op; the K-average after it is node-cache-warm
